BASE = 998244353
import heapq

N = 2 * 10**5

fac = [1]
inv_fac = [1]

for i in range(1, N + 1):
    fac.append((fac[-1] * i) % BASE)
    inv_fac.append((inv_fac[-1] * pow(i, BASE-2, BASE)) % BASE)
    assert (fac[i] * inv_fac[i] - 1) % BASE == 0


def fft(A,w):
    N=len(A)
    # assert (N & -N) == N
    if N<=1: return A
    even=fft(A[0::2],(w*w)%BASE)
    odd=fft(A[1::2],(w*w)%BASE)
    F=[0]*N
    x=1
    for j in range(0,N//2):
        F[j]=(even[j]+x*odd[j])%BASE
        F[j+N//2]=(even[j]-x*odd[j])%BASE
        x=(x*w)%BASE
    return F

def ifft(A,w):
    q = pow(len(A), BASE-2, BASE)
    return [(i*q)%BASE for i in fft(A, pow(w, BASE-2, BASE))]

root_order, root = 524288, 363395222

def convolve(A,B):
    # assert len(A) & -len(A) == len(A)
    w = pow(root, root_order // len(A), BASE)
    # assert pow(w, len(A), BASE) == 1
    u=fft(A,w)
    v=fft(B,w)
    return [u%BASE for u in ifft([(u[i]*v[i])%BASE for i in range(len(u))],w)]

def stirling_row(n, K):
    k = min(n, K)
    # https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stirling_numbers_of_the_second_kind#Explicit_formula
    # stirling(n, k) == inv_fac[k] * sum((-1)**(k - j) * binom(k, j) * (j**n) for j in range(k + 1))
    # = sum(((-1)**(k - j) * inv_fac[k - j]) * (inv_fac[j] * (j**n)) for j in range(k + 1))

    pad = (2 << (k.bit_length())) - (k + 1)
    A = [(pow(-1, j) * inv_fac[j]) % BASE for j in range(k + 1)] + [0] * pad
    B = [(pow(j, n, BASE) * inv_fac[j]) % BASE for j in range(k + 1)] + [0] * pad
    assert len(A) == len(B) == (len(A) & -len(A))
    R = convolve(A, B)
    return sum(R[1:k+1])

def solve(N, K):
    if K == 1: return 1

    muls = [0] * (N + 1)
    Q = [1]
    QV = {1: 1}

    while len(Q):
        n_div = Q[0]; heapq.heappop(Q)
        mul = QV[n_div]

        n = (N - 1) // n_div + 1
        muls[n] += mul

        for i in range(2, n + 1):
            n2 = (N - 1) // (n_div * i) + 1
            if n2 <= 0: break

            child = n_div * i
            if child not in QV:
                QV[child] = 0
                heapq.heappush(Q, child) 

            QV[child] = QV.get(child, 0) - mul


    ans = 0
    for n in range(1, N + 1):
        c = muls[n]
        if c == 0: continue
        term = stirling_row(n, K)
        ans += c * term
        # print(n, c, term, ans)

    return ans % BASE

while True:
    try:
        line = input().strip()
        if len(line) == 0: continue
        N, K = list(map(int, line.split(" ")))
    except EOFError:
        break

    print(solve(N, K))

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long BASE = 998244353;
    static final int N = 200000;
    static long[] fac = new long[N + 1];
    static long[] invFac = new long[N + 1];

    static final int rootOrder = 524288;
    static final long root = 363395222L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        initializeFactorials();
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLine()) {
            String line = sc.nextLine().trim();
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
            String[] parts = line.split(" ");
            int N_input = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
            int K_input = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
            System.out.println(solve(N_input, K_input));
        }
        sc.close();
    }

    static void initializeFactorials() {
        fac[0] = 1L;
        invFac[0] = 1L;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % BASE;
            invFac[i] = (invFac[i - 1] * modInverse(i, BASE)) % BASE;
        }
        // Optional assertion can be skipped in Java
    }

    static long modInverse(long a, long m) {
        return pow(a, m - 2, m);
    }

    static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1L;
        long cur = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * cur) % mod;
            }
            cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long[] fft(long[] A, long w) {
        int n = A.length;
        if (n <= 1) {
            return A;
        }

        long[] even = new long[n / 2];
        long[] odd = new long[n / 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
            even[i] = A[2 * i];
            odd[i] = A[2 * i + 1];
        }

        long[] evenFFT = fft(even, (w * w) % BASE);
        long[] oddFFT = fft(odd, (w * w) % BASE);
        long[] F = new long[n];
        long x = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; j++) {
            F[j] = (evenFFT[j] + x * oddFFT[j]) % BASE;
            F[j + n / 2] = (evenFFT[j] - x * oddFFT[j]) % BASE;
            if (F[j] < 0) F[j] += BASE;
            if (F[j + n / 2] < 0) F[j + n / 2] += BASE;
            x = (x * w) % BASE;
        }
        return F;
    }

    static long[] ifft(long[] A, long w) {
        int n = A.length;
        long invN = modInverse(n, BASE);
        long[] res = fft(A, modInverse(w, BASE));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = (res[i] * invN) % BASE;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long[] convolve(long[] A, long[] B) {
        int size = 1;
        int lenA = A.length;
        int lenB = B.length;
        while (size < lenA + lenB - 1) size <<= 1;

        long w = pow(root, rootOrder / size, BASE);
        long[] APad = new long[size];
        long[] BPad = new long[size];
        System.arraycopy(A, 0, APad, 0, lenA);
        System.arraycopy(B, 0, BPad, 0, lenB);
        long[] u = fft(APad, w);
        long[] v = fft(BPad, w);
        long[] res = new long[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            res[i] = (u[i] * v[i]) % BASE;
        }
        long[] c = ifft(res, w);
        return c;
    }

    static long stirlingRow(int n, int K) {
        int k = Math.min(n, K);
        int size = 1;
        while (size < 2 * (k + 1)) size <<= 1;

        long[] A = new long[size];
        long[] B = new long[size];

        for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
            long valA = ((j % 2 == 0 ? 1L : BASE - 1L) * invFac[j]) % BASE;
            A[j] = valA;
            long valB = (pow(j, n, BASE) * invFac[j]) % BASE;
            B[j] = valB;
        }

        long[] R = convolve(A, B);
        long sum = 0;
        for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
            sum = (sum + R[j]) % BASE;
        }
        return sum;
    }

    static long solve(int N, int K) {
        if (K == 1) return 1;

        long[] muls = new long[N + 1];
        Arrays.fill(muls, 0L);
        PriorityQueue<Integer> Q = new PriorityQueue<>();
        Map<Integer, Long> QV = new HashMap<>();
        Q.add(1);
        QV.put(1, 1L);

        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int n_div = Q.poll();
            long mul = QV.getOrDefault(n_div, 0L);
            int n = (N - 1) / n_div + 1;
            muls[n] += mul;

            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                int n2 = (N - 1) / (n_div * i) + 1;
                if (n2 <= 0) break;
                int child = n_div * i;
                QV.putIfAbsent(child, 0L);
                long childVal = QV.getOrDefault(child, 0L);
                QV.put(child, childVal - mul);
                if (!QV.containsKey(child) || QV.get(child) == 0) {
                    Q.add(child);
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int n = 1; n <= N; n++) {
            long c = muls[n];
            if (c == 0) continue;
            long term = stirlingRow(n, K);
            ans = (ans + c * term) % BASE;
        }

        return ans;
    }
}
